info.title: cisco-smart-license Event Notifications
info.description:
This module contains YANG definitions for Cisco Smart Licensing event notifications.

**Event Notifications Module** - Used for model-driven telemetry and streaming subscriptions with 24 notification types.

**Usage**: Subscribe to events via NETCONF/RESTCONF subscriptions

**Protocol**: RFC 8639 (Subscription to YANG Notifications)

**Authentication**: HTTP Basic Authentication

**YANG Model:** [cisco-smart-license.yang](https://github.com/YangModels/yang/blob/main/vendor/cisco/xe/17181/cisco-smart-license.yang)

**🌳 YANG Tree:** [View cisco-smart-license structure](https://jeremycohoe.github.io/cisco-ios-xe-openapi-swagger/yang-trees/cisco-smart-license.html)

get.description: Smart licensing ready notification

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: RESTCONF response media type (RFC 8040)

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Limit the depth of returned sub-tree data (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.2). Use 'unbounded' for full depth.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Select specific fields to return (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.3). Example: fields=name;status

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Filter by config state: 'config' (config true only), 'nonconfig' (config false only), or 'all'.
